# kioku

> A conservative local command exit-status cache with opt-in traced reuse.

Default runs execute; a hit does not replay output or artifacts. Trace reuse
requires Linux aarch64 or x86_64, a pinned tracer, a static child, and
explicit caller assumptions. It is not proof of hermeticity.

- [README](https://github.com/Rushford444/kioku/blob/main/README.md): installation, limits, and safety assumptions
- [Usage](https://github.com/Rushford444/kioku/blob/main/docs/usage.md): commands and output
- [Configuration](https://github.com/Rushford444/kioku/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): kioku.toml
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/Rushford444/kioku/blob/main/SKILL.md): machine usage
- [Security](https://github.com/Rushford444/kioku/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting and store sensitivity
